title: Toddler Sandy Lee at Healing Waters, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th century black and white square snapshot depicting a 15-month-old toddler named Sandy Lee standing proudly outdoors in a ruffled romper and ankle socks. Handwritten blue ink on the front white margins identifies the subject as 'Sandy Lee 15 mo' at top and 'Healing Waters' at the bottom.
